AssociateSourceServers.title: AssociateSourceServers
AssociateSourceServers.summary: To migrate servers as a group, you must first associate the migration sources with that group.

CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob.title: CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob
CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob.summary: Server Migration Center (SMC) lets you migrate an Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to a different zone within the same region and change its instance type, including the vCPU and memory, within the same instance family. This feature helps you meet business requirements for instance migration and specification changes. Call this operation to create a cross-zone migration job.

CreateReplicationJob.title: Create a migration task
CreateReplicationJob.summary: Creates a migration task for a migration source by calling CreateReplicationJob.

CreateWorkgroup.title: CreateWorkgroup
CreateWorkgroup.summary: Workgroups are used to manage the lifecycle of multiple migration tasks in batch server migration scenarios.

CutOverReplicationJob.title: CutOverReplicationJob
CutOverReplicationJob.summary: Stops the periodic execution of a specified incremental migration job and completes the migration.

DeleteReplicationJob.title: DeleteReplicationJob
DeleteReplicationJob.summary: You can call DeleteReplicationJob to delete a migration job.

DeleteSourceServer.title: DeleteSourceServer
DeleteSourceServer.summary: You can call the DeleteSourceServer operation to delete a migration source.

DeleteWorkgroup.title: DeleteWorkgroup
DeleteWorkgroup.summary: You can delete a workgroup that you no longer need.

DescribeReplicationJobs.title: DescribeReplicationJobs
DescribeReplicationJobs.summary: Retrieves details about one or more migration tasks.

DescribeSourceServers.title: DescribeSourceServers
DescribeSourceServers.summary: Call the DescribeSourceServers operation to query information about one or more migration sources.

DescribeWorkgroups.title: DescribeWorkgroups
DescribeWorkgroups.summary: After a workgroup is created, you can view its information, such as the workgroup name, description, and alert information.

DisableAccessToken.title: DisableAccessToken
DisableAccessToken.summary: You can call the DisableAccessToken operation to disable an activation code.

DisassociateSourceServers.title: DisassociateSourceServers
DisassociateSourceServers.summary: Disassociate a migration source from a group if you no longer need to use the group for batch migration or want to delete the group.

ListAccessTokens.title: ListAccessTokens
ListAccessTokens.summary: Call the ListAccessTokens operation to query for created activation codes and their statuses.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags attached to one or more SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks.

ModifyReplicationJobAttribute.title: ModifyReplicationJobAttribute
ModifyReplicationJobAttribute.summary: You can call the ModifyReplicationJobAttribute operation to modify the information of a migration task.

ModifySourceServerAttribute.title: ModifySourceServerAttribute
ModifySourceServerAttribute.summary: The ModifySourceServerAttribute operation modifies the name and description of a migration source.

ModifyWorkgroupAttribute.title: ModifyWorkgroupAttribute
ModifyWorkgroupAttribute.summary: Modifies a workgroup's name and description.

StartReplicationJob.title: StartReplicationJob
StartReplicationJob.summary: You can call the StartReplicationJob operation to start a migration task.

StopReplicationJob.title: StopReplicationJob
StopReplicationJob.summary: You can call the StopReplicationJob operation to stop a migration task.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: You can call TagResources to create and attach tags to multiple SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Detaches and deletes tags from specified SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks.
